summary: This is a Mol Labs public report (P20) proposing an assumption-kill experiment to test whether Semax (ACTH(4-7)-PGP) retains neurotrophin-induction or recovery phenotype when BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution is abolished via TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody. The document frames the claim as a pre-registered prediction (residual ≥50% of Semax without-TrkB-block arm) and identifies four key literature priors (Shadrina, Dmitrieva, Dolotov, Agapova) that establish BDNF/NGF induction by Semax but none of which include the required TrkB-block/BDNF-neutralize H2H arm. The experiment has not been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN), and the key residual variable is classified as UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Document Overview and Claim
content_blocks.content: Mol Labs public report P20 (PUBLIC_REPORT_ONLY, private=NONE). Semax (ACTH(4-7)-PGP / Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro) is framed as inducing BDNF/NGF and TrkB-linked neurotrophin transcription. The central claim (assumption-kill / trkb-insufficiency): On a matched insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody panel titrated to abolish BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution, residual Semax neurotrophin-induction or recovery remains ≥50% of the Semax without-TrkB-block / without-BDNF-neutralize arm. This is a pre-registered prediction; the experiment has NOT been run (execution_status=NOT_RUN). Status label: NEGATIVE. Novelty tag: assumption-kill. Polarity: negative. Risk class: research-discussion.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Scientific Rationale
content_blocks.content: Four literature anchors establish Semax neurotrophin induction: Shadrina (NGF/BDNF gene-expression dynamics), Dmitrieva (Semax/PGP neurotrophin+receptor transcription after pMCAO), Dolotov (Semax BDNF/trkB hippocampus regulation with cognitive phenotype), and Agapova (Semax neurotrophin gene expression in normal rat brain). None of these studies include a TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralize arm that abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution. P20 asks whether residual Semax neurotrophin-induction/recovery under such a block still requires a path beyond BDNF-class attribution (trkb-insufficiency assumption-kill). Explicitly distinct from P15 (BPC residual-FBXO22), P16 (LKKTETQ-Cc), P17 (MOTS-c/folate), P18 (SS-31/ROS-scavenger), P19 (ARA290/IRR), and N17 (Hericium/NGF-TrkA).

content_blocks.title: Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: trkb-insufficiency assumption-kill: All four literature priors (Shadrina, Dmitrieva, Dolotov, Agapova) are classified as LITERATURE and none score residual Semax under a TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralize condition that abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution on the same panel. BDNF/NGF induction framing is the class PRIOR under kill — PRIOR induction ≠ matched residual H2H under TrkB-block abolish. P20 scores residual neurotrophin-induction / recovery under TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralize that first abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution, on the same insult ± Semax ± TrkB-block / BDNF-neutralize panel. Preferred approach: named published Semax neurotrophin panel (hippocampus/cortex/ischemia) with TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralizing Ab / explant before new animal/human.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art Summary
content_blocks.content:
Four prior art references identified:
1. PMID 19662538 / DOI 10.1007/s12031-009-9270-z — Shadrina: Semax alters temporary dynamics of NGF and BDNF gene expression in rat hippocampus, frontal cortex, and retina. Classification: BDNF/NGF induction prior; NOT residual-under-TrkB-block H2H.
2. PMID 19633950 / DOI 10.1007/s10571-009-9432-0 / PMC11498467 — Dmitrieva: Semax and Pro-Gly-Pro activate transcription of neurotrophins and their receptor genes after permanent MCAO in rat cortex. Classification: neurotrophin+receptor transcription prior; NOT residual under TrkB-block / BDNF-neutralize abolish.
3. PMID 16996037 / DOI 10.1016/j.brainres.2006.07.108 — Dolotov: Semax regulates BDNF and trkB expression in rat hippocampus; BDNF protein / trkB phosphorylation / exon-III BDNF and trkB mRNA increased; cognitive conditioned-avoidance phenotype. Classification: BDNF/trkB induction prior; NOT residual H2H under TrkB antagonist or BDNF neutralize.
4. PMID 17353092 / DOI 10.1016/j.neulet.2007.02.042 — Agapova: Semax induces rapid gene- and region-specific NGF/BDNF expression changes in normal rat brain (hippocampus, brainstem, cerebellum, frontal cortex). Classification: neurotrophin-induction prior; NOT TrkB-block residual.

content_blocks.title: Prediction Variables Table
content_blocks.content:
Six prediction variables defined:
1. Shadrina_Semax_NGF_BDNF_gene_dynamics — KIND: LITERATURE — Assay: Male Wistar rats; Semax; hippocampus/frontal cortex/retina; NGF and BDNF gene expression by real-time PCR; time course 20 min–24 h — Status: BDNF/NGF induction prior confirmed (PMID 19662538); NOT residual-under-TrkB-block H2H.
2. Dmitrieva_Semax_PGP_ischemia_neurotrophin_receptor_transcription — KIND: LITERATURE — Assay: Rat permanent MCAO; Semax vs PGP; cortex neurotrophin (Bdnf, Ngf, Nt-3) and receptor (TrkA/B/C) transcription at 3/24/72 h — Status: confirmed LITERATURE (PMID 19633950); NOT residual-under-TrkB-block H2H.
3. Dolotov_Semax_BDNF_trkB_hippocampus — KIND: LITERATURE — Assay: Rat hippocampus; intranasal Semax; BDNF protein; trkB tyrosine phosphorylation; exon III BDNF and trkB mRNA; conditioned avoidance — Status: confirmed LITERATURE (PMID 16996037); NOT residual-under-TrkB-block H2H.
4. Agapova_Semax_neurotrophin_gene_expression_normal_brain — KIND: LITERATURE — Assay: Male Wistar rats; intranasal Semax; NGF/BDNF gene expression by real-time PCR in hippocampus, brainstem, cerebellum, frontal cortex — Status: confirmed LITERATURE (PMID 17353092); NOT residual-under-TrkB-block H2H.
5. matched_residual_Semax_under_TrkB_antagonist_BDNF_neutralize_H2H — KIND: UNKNOWN — Assay: Same insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody panel — Status: UNKNOWN + missing_search; dedicated residual not found (QX_ANA12=0 / Q2 residual=0).
6. residual_Semax_neurotrophin_ge50pct_of_Semax_without_TrkB_block — KIND: PREDICTION — Assay: Pre-registered matched insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody panel; TrkB-block must abolish BDNF-class attribution first — Threshold: residual ≥50% of Semax without-TrkB-block arm; α/N pre-specified; do not invent observed % / KD / dosing.
7. competing_incomplete_TrkB_block_or_BDNF_attribution_not_abolished_inconclusive — KIND: PREDICTION — Competing outcomes: incomplete TrkB-block, BDNF-class attribution not abolished, absent residual, or block-QC failure → inconclusive (not refute).

content_blocks.title: Baseline Claimed and Measured
content_blocks.content: Baseline claimed: Under TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralize that abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution, Semax still retains neurotrophin-induction or recovery phenotype on the same panel. Baseline measured: All four literature priors (Shadrina, Dmitrieva, Dolotov, Agapova) confirmed as LITERATURE but scored without TrkB-antagonist / BDNF-neutralize arm that abolishes BDNF-class attribution. Matched residual Semax neurotrophin-induction / recovery under TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralize: UNKNOWN (soft-complete Q1 NON-MATCH / Q1b PRIOR NON-MATCH / QX_ANA12=0 / Q2 residual=0). Residual ≥50% of Semax without-TrkB-block arm: PREDICTION. Seed PMIDs 22295573 / 18756821 lack DOI — out of public prior_art.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
Three key limitations:
1. P1–P19 do not prove P20 — Shadrina/Dmitrieva/Dolotov/Agapova BDNF/NGF/TrkB induction priors are not a residual-under-TrkB-antagonist / BDNF-neutralize H2H; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated residual phenotype.
2. Skip-list / series distinctness (critical) — do not collapse to OpenLabs BPC orthosteric dialect, P15 residual-FBXO22, P16 LKKTETQ-Cc, P17 MOTS-c/folate, P18 SS-31/ROS-scavenger, P19 ARA290/IRR, or N17 Hericium/NGF-TrkA; orthosteric_drift=false; NOT FOXO4×LOF.
3. Shadrina/Dmitrieva/Dolotov/Agapova lack TrkB-antagonist / BDNF-neutralize arm; incomplete TrkB-block / BDNF-class attribution not abolished / no residual to score / block-QC failure leave the test inconclusive rather than refuted; no dosing; seed PMIDs 22295573 / 18756821 lack DOI.

content_blocks.title: Ablation Analysis
content_blocks.content:
Three ablation conditions identified:
1. Remove matched insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralizing antibody panel: Without the TrkB-block / BDNF-neutralize × residual H2H, separate literature priors cannot show trkb-insufficiency of residual Semax under TrkB-block abolish.
2. Remove TrkB-block / BDNF-neutralize abolish gate plus Semax without-TrkB-block comparator: Without the abolish gate and named comparator, the card collapses into Shadrina/Dmitrieva/Dolotov/Agapova phenotype prior or generic BDNF-induction framing and loses trkb-insufficiency contrast.
3. Remove P15≠P20 + P16≠P20 + P17≠P20 + P18≠P20 + P19≠P20 + N17≠P20 + P1–P19≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠novelty + skip-list-distinct + NOT-FOXO4×LOF discipline: Treating prior series or empty PubMed as deciding residual-under-TrkB-block would invent an H2H result left UNKNOWN.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria and Human Ask
content_blocks.content:
Refute if: On the pre-registered matched insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody panel where TrkB-block / BDNF-neutralize abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution, residual Semax neurotrophin-induction / recovery is <50% of the Semax without-TrkB-block / without-BDNF-neutralize arm — so BDNF-class-attribution framing survives and trkb-insufficiency residual fails — when incomplete TrkB-block, BDNF-class attribution-not-abolished, absent residual, or block-QC artifacts are ruled out.
Ask a human: Lock one insult ± Semax ± TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody system with block QC that abolishes BDNF-class neurotrophin attribution, neurotrophin-induction / recovery readout, and ≥50%-of-Semax-without-TrkB-block residual gate before claiming residual under TrkB-block; prefer named published Semax neurotrophin panel (hippocampus/cortex/ischemia) with TrkB antagonist / BDNF neutralizing Ab / explant before new animal/human.

The key experimental variable — matched residual Semax neurotrophin-induction/recovery under TrkB antagonist (e.g., ANA-12) and/or BDNF neutralizing antibody that abolishes BDNF-class attribution — is classified as UNKNOWN (QX_ANA12=0, Q2 residual=0, missing_search).

The pre-registered prediction is that residual Semax neurotrophin-induction/recovery under TrkB-block/BDNF-neutralize condition will be ≥50% of the Semax without-TrkB-block arm on the same panel; this is a PREDICTION, not an observed result.
Execution status is NOT_RUN; FTO status is UNKNOWN; the experiment is proposed but has not been conducted.

Competing inconclusive outcomes pre-registered: incomplete TrkB-block, BDNF-class attribution not abolished, absent residual to score, or block-QC failure — these are inconclusive, not refuting.
